data.name: Drift Vale
data.detailed_description:
《Drift Vale》is a fantasy 3D platforming Metroidvania that centers around a unique boomerang mechanic. Master fluid parkour and agile combat as you explore seven distinct regions. Defeat powerful bosses to unlock hidden abilities and uncover the long-buried truth of the vale.   

“Wake up…”

“Come to me… child of the chosen.”

You awaken in a forgotten gorge, lost and alone. With no memory of where you came from or how to escape, your only guide is a whisper echoing from deep within the valley.

Guided by the voice, you gain the power of the boomerang — a tool that lets you move freely through the vale, push and pull enemies, and interact dynamically with the environment. Along your journey through Drift Vale, you’ll face ancient spectral guardians, each battle a test of memory and self. Only by overcoming them will you unlock the boomerang’s true potential, gain new powers, piece together your forgotten past, and uncover the path home — along with the truth of who you are.

Game Feature

  • Wield the Power of the Boomerang
    Your boomerang isn’t just a weapon — it’s an extension of yourself. Use it to attack, pull enemies close, trigger switches, repel danger, or even interact with the environment. Every throw is a decision — attack, survive, or unlock the way forward.

  • Chain Moves with Fluid Flow
    Chain together dashes, wall runs, wall jumps, and flips to navigate treacherous terrain. Movement is silky and responsive — a key to both survival and expression.

  • Intense Boss Encounters
    Each battle is a ritual, testing not just your skill, but what you've become. Every encounter challenges your timing, adaptability, and everything you’ve learned so far.

  • Seven Interconnected Realms
    Explore the surreal and magical biomes of Drift Vale — from mist-covered cliffs and coral-infested shores to starlit crystal caverns. Each region weaves light environmental storytelling with secrets hidden off the main path.

  • A Focused, Compact Adventure
    A concise but full Metroidvania experience, blending exploration, challenge, and story in just a few hours — perfect for those who love immersive fantasy journeys.

data.short_description: Fall into Drift Vale — a 3D Metroidvania set in a forsaken world of towering cliffs and ancient, deadly spirits. Chain fluid movement, master the boomerang, and unlock hidden powers — it’s the only way to survive the one-way ritual.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700 | AMD Ryzen 7 1800X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 | AMD Radeon RX 460
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-10900K | AMD Ryzen 9 3900X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 super | AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
